# A known open choice blocks only its linked work and still permits a complete report.
exec ctx orient --bundle bundle
! stderr .
stdout 'Evaluation: complete; inventory: complete'
stdout 'state: open'
stdout 'state: resolved'
stdout 'resolution: Use offline storage\.'
stdout 'decision check: fail'
stdout 'decision check: pass'
stdout 'Affected work:'
stdout 'blocked \[blocked\]'
stdout 'blocking_decisions: fail'
stdout 'blocking_decisions: pass'
stdout 'readiness: blocked'
stdout 'readiness: ready; eligible: true'
stdout 'decision remains open'
stdout 'blocked_by_decision.*blocked.md.*open.md'

exec ctx orient --bundle bundle --json
! stderr .
cp stdout result.json
jsonorientation result.json true
stdout '"state":"resolved","resolution":"Use offline storage\."'
stdout '"checkStatus":"fail"'
stdout '"checkStatus":"pass"'
stdout '"affectedWork":\[\{[^}]*"id":"blocked"'
stdout '"code":"open_decision"'
stdout '"kind":"blocked_by_decision"'
stdout '"shortlist":\[\{[^}]*"id":"unrelated"[^}]*\},\{[^}]*"id":"resolved-work"'

# Invalid state makes the linked work unknown and retains useful unrelated facts.
cp invalid-open.md bundle/open.md
exit 1 ctx orient --bundle bundle
! stderr .
stdout 'Open decisions: unknown'
stdout 'state: unknown'
stdout 'decision check: unknown'
stdout 'blocking_decisions: unknown'
stdout 'readiness: unknown'
exit 1 ctx orient --bundle bundle --json
! stderr .
cp stdout result.json
jsonorientation result.json false
stdout '"state":null'
stdout '"checkStatus":"unknown"'
stdout '"shortlist":\[\{[^}]*"id":"unrelated"'

# A missing decision is a partial report rather than an operation failure.
rm bundle/open.md
exit 1 ctx orient --bundle bundle
! stderr .
stdout 'Open decisions: unknown'
stdout 'source_missing'
stdout 'blocking_decisions: unknown'
stdout 'readiness: ready; eligible: true'
exit 1 ctx orient --bundle bundle --json
! stderr .
cp stdout result.json
jsonorientation result.json false
stdout 'source_missing'
stdout '"readiness":"unknown"'
